en.title: New Cat Species Discovered Before GTA 6 Release Date
en.summary: While the world eagerly awaits Grand Theft Auto VI, scientists have made a remarkable discovery in the Bolivian Yungas forest. A new species of tiger cat, Leopardus tilcayo, has been identified, marking the first new cat species found in over a century.
en.body:
The wait for **Rockstar Games' Grand Theft Auto VI** has been one of the longest and most anticipated in gaming history. Since **GTA V** first launched in 2013, the world has seen countless technological advancements, cultural shifts, and even the discovery of new life forms. This week, the scientific community announced the identification of *Leopardus tilcayo*, affectionately nicknamed the tilcayo tiger cat, a creature so elusive it remained unknown until now.

This tiny feline, smaller than a typical housecat and adorned with distinctive spots and round ears, was found in the dense Bolivian Yungas forest. Its discovery, detailed in the journal *Current Biology*, is a significant event, representing the first new cat species to be documented in over 100 years. The story of its discovery is as fascinating as the cat itself. Paola Nogales-Ascarrunz, a co-author of the report, stumbled upon the species almost by accident while volunteering at a wildlife rehabilitation facility. A man brought in a tiny cat he was caring for, but unable to continue, and genetic testing soon revealed it was an entirely new species.

## The Long Road to Vice City

The **Grand Theft Auto VI** development cycle began shortly after **GTA V**'s release, and the time elapsed has been so vast that it has fueled countless memes with the phrase, "We got ___ before GTA VI." From **Halo** making its way to PlayStation to over fifteen **Call of Duty** titles and the entire tenure of **Phil Spencer** as Xbox CEO, a surprising amount has transpired in the gaming world while **Rockstar** meticulously crafted its next opus. **Take-Two Interactive** CEO Strauss Zelnick has acknowledged these viral sentiments, confirming he's seen many of the memes. The immense anticipation is palpable, with fans scrutinizing every piece of information for clues about the return to **Vice City**.

## A Community United by Waiting

For gamers, the extended development period of **GTA VI** has become a shared experience, a running joke, and a testament to **Rockstar's** commitment to delivering a polished, expansive world. The discovery of the tilcayo tiger cat serves as a quirky, yet apt, reminder of how much can happen in the time it takes for one of gaming's most ambitious titles to reach completion. It highlights the slow, deliberate pace of scientific discovery mirroring, in a strange way, the patient wait for **Rockstar's** next masterpiece. The community's reaction to the cat's discovery has been largely positive, with many finding humor in the timing and embracing the new animal as a mascot for the ongoing wait.

## What's Next

**Grand Theft Auto VI** is officially slated for release on November 19, 2026, for **PlayStation 5** and **Xbox Series X|S**. Players in regions like New Zealand may gain access to the game approximately 18 hours before those on the U.S. East Coast, potentially leading to earlier spoiler leaks online.

content_raw: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 has been in development since 2015 , and a lot of things have happened since then, including the recent discovery a new species of cat. The scientific journal Current Biology disclosed the discovery of Leopardus tilcayo--known as the tilcayo tiger cat--this week. The adorable little creature is smaller than your typical housecat, featuring spots and round ears. According to the discovery, the cat species was found in the Bolivian Yungas forest. The tilcayo tiger cat is the first new cat species discovered in over 100 years. Paola Nogales-Ascarrunz, a co-author of the report, told NBC News that it is currently unknown how many of the cats remain in the wild. She said she discovered the cat basically by accident. She volunteers at a wildlife rehab facility close to La Paz, Bolivia and noticed a tiny cat that she thought was a kitten. The cat was brought to the facility by a man who was caring for it, feeding it rice and eggs, and later giving it up when he was unable to care for it. Genetic testing was undertaken, and it was discovered that it was indeed a brand-new species of cat never before discovered or documented. As for more gaming-related things that have happened since GTA 5 came out, GameSpot recently assembled a collection of some of the biggest news stories, including Halo coming to PlayStation, the release of 15+ Call of Duty games, the entire run of Phil Spencer as Xbox CEO , and more. The wait for GTA 6 has been so long that it's spawned the, “We got ___ before GTA VI” meme. Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick said he is aware of these memes. “I’ve seen some of those," he said . The wait for GTA 6 is nearly over, as the game is scheduled for release on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. The game will not ship on a disc, but if you want a disc with GTA 6 printed on it, you can buy the game's soundtrack .
